title: ceradenia bishopii

It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ceradenia bishopii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Ceradenia bishopii, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer and anti-viral effects.
